 * @description Inefficient regular expressions that can lead to Denial of Service.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.Concepts

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "split", "sub", "subn"]).getACall()
  and exists(string regex |

    and (
      // Basic check for nested quantifiers or overlapping repetition (simplified heuristic)

      regex.regexpMatch(".*\\(.+\\*\\)\\*.*") or
      regex.regexpMatch(".*\\(.+\\+\\)\\*.*") or
      regex.regexpMatch(".*\\(.+\\*\\)\\+.*")
    )
  )
